repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard specifically designed for AI coding agents.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based local dashboard with support for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenRouter.
Purpose: Provides granular visibility into agentic workflows by breaking down tasks into individual steps.
Use Cases: Auditing agent performance, calculating exact token/time costs per task, and debugging failed coding sessions.
Finance/Tech Relevance: Essential for engineering managers and developers to manage the ROI and operational costs of AI-driven development.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, local-first dashboard for A-share market sentiment analysis and short-term trading review.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based local execution; utilizes deterministic mathematical models for sentiment metrics rather than relying solely on AI.
Purpose: Computes complex market indicators like liquidity, sentiment cycles, and ladder tiers to visualize market 'money flow'.
Use Cases: Daily market review, identifying short-term trading opportunities, and monitoring market sentiment without API dependency.
Finance/Tech Relevance: Offers a transparent, data-driven approach to quantitative market analysis for retail and professional traders.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first, multimodal time-series visualization and data infrastructure tool built in Rust.
bullets: Tech Stack: Rust-based, hard fork of Rerun, featuring native ROS 2 integration and high-performance data handling.
Purpose: Provides a robust infrastructure for visualizing and analyzing complex, time-synchronized multimodal data streams.
Use Cases: Debugging autonomous systems, analyzing sensor fusion data, and replaying historical recordings for diagnostic purposes.
Finance/Tech Relevance: High-frequency data visualization is critical for quantitative finance and algorithmic trading systems that require low-latency monitoring.
